scope__license_tiers.quote: "Apprentice electrician" shall mean a person who is licensed by the Board and whose principal occupation is the learning and assisting in the performance of electrical services.

"Journeyperson electrician" shall mean a person who is qualified and skilled to perform electrical work and who has met the requirements of § 1408 of this title to be licensed as a journeyperson electrician.

"Master electrician" shall mean a person, licensed by the Board, to plan, estimate, layout, perform or supervise the installation, erection or repair of any electrical conductor, molding, duct, raceway, conduit, machinery, apparatus, device or fixture for the purpose of lighting, heating or power in any structure.
